references.text: God's original instruction to Moses to make two gold rings under the crown on the incense altar to carry it with poles.
The same construction principle with gold rings and carrying poles was used for the ark of the covenant, showing a consistent pattern for holy objects in the tabernacle.
Bezalel made similar gold rings and carrying poles for the ark of the covenant, demonstrating the parallel in the construction of the tabernacle's sacred items.
Bezalel also made gold rings and carrying poles for the table of showbread with the same purpose—to make it possible to carry the object.
The bronze altar also had rings and carrying poles, showing that all the altars in the tabernacle were designed to be portable.
Complementary action: Making the rings (source) followed by inserting the poles (candidate).
